items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: I'd learned myself how to set my time and everything from what I've heard, Baby Dots and Henry Martin and Red Happy used to do.

ctx.x: Well, after I'd get up in the daytime, wash up and eat, I'd sit down and practice with a little 10 cents gazoot. Oh, yeah. Yeah. And that's how I learned myself how to set my time and everything from what I've heard, Baby Dots and Henry Martin and Red Happy used to do. Yeah. Because a lot of time I used to go to the Lyrics Theater when the old Professor Joe Robichow was playing at the old Lyrics Theater. Yeah. Well, Happy was on drums and then one time he had Black Benny on drums with him. Oh, yeah. Well, Black…

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: I used to watch Baby Dots do that you know and that's where I learned that from him

ctx.x: Had you played any other instruments first? Any like guitar? No, no other instruments.
I was just crazy about drums from a child when Baby Dots was playing in New Orleans at that time. Baby Dots, Henry Martin, Black Benny, Two Bits, and all those drummers.
Well tell me, I don't want to interrupt you all the time, but tell me about Two Bits. I know Bunk used to mention Two Bits, and I never heard anybody else mention it until you did.
